contentText: “His main political platform is to say, I am not Sánchez, I am the opposite of Sánchez.” As Spain heads to the polls, what do Alberto Núñez Feijóo's campaign and political career tell us about the kind of prime minister he might become? Javier Carbonell, Policy Analyst at the European Politics and Institutions Programme and lecturer at Sciences Po in Paris, joins Gavin Lee to break down the Popular Party leader's efforts to avoid the mistakes of 2023 and keep right-wing voters mobilised without galvanising the left.
